## L1: native output.minify.mangleProps on the unbundled build (p1.config.ts, and p1 without `cache`)
with cache:    [INVALID_OPTION] Invalid value for option "output.minify.mangleProps" - property mangling is currently supported only when a build generates one JavaScript chunk. Use a single-chunk build or remove "mangleProps".
without cache: the same error
=> unchanged: the plugin and the map's single-chunk build stay.

## L2: declaration-map references, one configuration with sourcemap: true (p4.config.ts, DTS=...)
DTS=true                    27 .d.ts, 0 with sourceMappingURL, 0 .d.ts.map, 30 .js.map
DTS={"sourcemap":false}     27 .d.ts, 0 with sourceMappingURL, 0 .d.ts.map, 30 .js.map
DTS={"sourcemap":true}      27 .d.ts, 22 with sourceMappingURL, 22 .d.ts.map, 30 .js.map
current tsdown.config.ts (pcur, dts: true, renamer, no minify): 27 .d.ts, 0 with sourceMappingURL
previously (0.29.0-beta.2): DTS=true and DTS={"sourcemap":false} gave 22 of 27 .d.ts with a dangling reference
mechanism, read in node_modules/rolldown-plugin-dts/dist/index.mjs (0.30.2), createFakeJsPlugin's generateBundle:
  when its sourcemap option is off, each .d.ts chunk's trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=` line is removed, and chunk.map and chunk.sourcemapFileName are cleared.
  its sourcemap option defaults to compilerOptions.declarationMap, which tsconfig.base.json doesn't set.
=> L2 lifted: declaration maps and their references are off independently of the JavaScript maps, in one configuration.
